items.q: Do you train in person or online?
items.a: Both. In-person sessions are available in the areas listed below, and online coaching works anywhere in the world.

items.q: How long is a transformation program?
items.a: Programs run for 12 to 16 weeks, depending on your starting point and goal. That is long enough for real, visible change and short enough to stay focused.

items.q: I'm a complete beginner. Is that okay?
items.a: Absolutely. Most clients start with little or no gym experience. We start where you are and build from there.

items.q: How soon will I see results?
items.a: Most people notice changes in strength and energy within 2–3 weeks and visible changes in 6–8 weeks, if they follow the plan consistently.

items.q: Do I have to give up foods I like?
items.a: No. Your nutrition plan is built around food you already enjoy. Consistency beats perfection.

items.q: What does the free consultation include?
items.a: A short call to understand your goal and situation. You'll leave with honest advice, whether or not we end up working together.
